subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-inject SKILL.md content when skill is invoked via slash command

question: Should explicit non-tool skill slash commands automatically inject SKILL.md into model context, and what instruction-authority boundary must apply before that happens?
rationale: The requested behavior changes prompt authority for installed or workspace skill content and overlaps open instruction-isolation work, so automation should not choose the permanent trust boundary alone.

options.title: Design the boundary first
options.body: Define the trusted/untrusted SKILL.md precedence, visibility, and session-context contract, then implement forced slash invocation against that approved design.

options.title: Keep command-dispatch as the deterministic path
options.body: Preserve the current model-routed default and require skills that need hard activation to use command-dispatch: tool until broader isolation is settled.

options.title: Prototype behind an explicit opt-in
options.body: Allow a narrow experimental forced-injection mode only after maintainers accept the upgrade and security tradeoff for existing skills.

recommendation.title: Design the boundary first
recommendation.body: Define the trusted/untrusted SKILL.md precedence, visibility, and session-context contract, then implement forced slash invocation against that approved design.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the slash-command skill surface and is the strongest available routing candidate for the product/security decision.
